title.en: Volume 20 Biographies 12: Zhang Qiong; Hu Luqiang; Yao Xiong; Song Xian; Wang Ze; Murong Shaozong; Xue Xiuyi; Chi Lieping; Buda Hansa; Murong Yan
title.raw: 卷二十 列傳第十二 張瓊 斛律羌 堯雄 宋顯 王則 慕容紹宗 薛脩義 叱列平 步大汗薩 慕容儼 Volume 20 Biographies 12: Zhang Qiong; Hu Luqiang; Yao Xiong; Song Xian; Wang Ze; Murong Shaozong; Xue Xiuyi; Chi Lieping; Buda Hansa; Murong Yan

sentences.zh: 張瓊，字連德，代人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Qiong, styled Liande, was a native of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiong, styled Liande, was a native of Dai.

sentences.zh: 少壯健，有武用。

translations.literal: In youth he was strong and robust, and possessed martial ability.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was strong and robust, and possessed martial ability.

sentences.zh: 魏世自蕩寇將軍為朔州征虜府外兵參軍，隨葛榮為亂。

translations.literal: During the Wei era he rose from General Who Sweeps Bandits to outside-military military assistant in the expeditionary office of Shuo Province, and followed Ge Rong in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wei era he rose from general who sweeps bandits to outside-military military assistant in the expeditionary office of Shuo Province, and followed Ge Rong in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 榮敗，尒朱榮以為都督。

translations.literal: When Ge was defeated, Erzhu Rong made him a commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Ge was defeated, Erzhu Rong made him a commander.

sentences.zh: 討元顥有功，除汲郡太守。

translations.literal: For merit in attacking Yuan Hao he was appointed Administrator of Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in attacking Yuan Hao he was appointed administrator of Ji Commandery.

sentences.zh: 建明初，為東道尉勞大使，封行唐縣子，邑三百戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianming he was made envoy comforting the army on the eastern route, enfeoffed Viscount of Xingtang County with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianming he was made envoy comforting the army on the eastern route, enfeoffed viscount of Xingtang County with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 轉太尉長史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to chief clerk of the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to chief clerk of the grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 出為河內太守，除濟州刺史。

translations.literal: He went out as Administrator of Henei and was appointed Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as administrator of Henei and was appointed governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 尒朱兆敗，歸高祖，遷汾州刺史。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Zhao was defeated, he returned to the Grand Ancestor and was transferred to Governor of Fen Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Zhao was defeated, he returned to Gao Huan and was transferred to governor of Fen Province.

sentences.zh: 天平中，高祖襲克夏州，以為尉勞大使，仍留鎮之。

translations.literal: During Tianping, the Grand Ancestor seized Xia Province by surprise; Qiong was made envoy comforting the army and was left to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping, Gao Huan seized Xia Province by surprise; Zhang Qiong was made envoy comforting the army and was left to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 尋為周文帝所陷，卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was trapped by Emperor Wen of Zhou and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was trapped by Yuwen Tai and died.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、燕恒雲朔四州諸軍事、大將軍、司徒公、恒州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Yan, Heng, Yun, and Shuo, grand general, Duke over the Masses, and Governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of military affairs in the four provinces of Yan, Heng, Yun, and Shuo, grand general, duke over the masses, and governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 有二子。

translations.literal: He had two sons.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons.

sentences.zh: 長忻，次遵業。

translations.literal: The eldest was Xin, the second Zunye.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest was Xin, the second Zunye.

sentences.zh: 忻，普泰中為都督，隨尒朱世隆。

translations.literal: Xin, during Putai, was made a commander and followed Erzhu Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: Xin, during Putai, was made a commander and followed Erzhu Shilong.

sentences.zh: 以功尚魏平陽公主，除駙馬都尉、大將軍、開府儀同三司、建州刺史、南鄭縣伯。

translations.literal: For merit he married the Princess of Pingyang of Wei, and was appointed Commandant of the Horse-guarding Consorts, Grand General, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, Governor of Jian Province, and Baron of Nanzheng County.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he married the Princess of Pingyang of Wei, and was appointed commandant of the horse-guarding consorts, grand general, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, governor of Jian Province, and baron of Nanzheng County.

sentences.zh: 瓊常憂其太盛，每語親識曰：「凡人官爵，莫若處中，忻位秩太高，深為憂慮。

translations.literal: Qiong often worried that his rank was too high; he would tell close friends and acquaintances, "For any man, in office and rank nothing is better than holding the middle; Xin's rank is too high — I am deeply anxious about it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiong often worried that his rank was too high; he would tell close friends and acquaintances, "For any man, in office and rank nothing is better than holding the middle; Xin's rank is too high — I am deeply anxious about it.

sentences.zh: 」而忻豪險放縱，遂與公主情好不協，尋為武帝所害，時稱瓊之先見。

translations.literal: " But Xin was arrogant, dangerous, and unrestrained; he soon fell out with the princess, and was shortly killed by Emperor Wu — at the time people praised Qiong's foresight.
translations.idiomatic: " But Xin was arrogant, dangerous, and unrestrained; he soon fell out with the princess, and was shortly killed by Emperor Wu of Wei — at the time people praised Zhang Qiong's foresight.

sentences.zh: 張遵業

translations.literal: Zhang Zunye
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zunye

sentences.zh: 遵業，討元顥有功，封固安縣開國子，除寧遠將軍、雲州大中正。

translations.literal: Zunye, for merit in attacking Yuan Hao, was enfeoffed Establishing-the-State Viscount of Gu'an County, and appointed General of Tranquil Distance and Grand Rectifier of Yun Province.
translations.idiomatic: Zunye, for merit in attacking Yuan Hao, was enfeoffed establishing-the-state viscount of Gu'an County, and appointed general of tranquil distance and grand rectifier of Yun Province.

sentences.zh: 天平中，除清河太守，尋加安西將軍、建州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tianping he was appointed Administrator of Qinghe, and soon was additionally made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jian Province.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he was appointed administrator of Qinghe, and soon was additionally made general who pacifies the west and governor of Jian Province.

sentences.zh: 武定中，隨儀同劉豐討侯景，為景所擒。

translations.literal: During Wuding he followed Equal in Protocol Liu Feng in attacking Hou Jing, and was captured by Jing.
translations.idiomatic: During Wuding he followed Equal in Protocol Liu Feng in attacking Hou Jing, and was captured by Jing.

sentences.zh: 景敗，殺遵業於渦陽。

translations.literal: When Jing was defeated, he killed Zunye at Woyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing was defeated, he killed Zunye at Woyang.

sentences.zh: 喪還，世宗親自臨吊，贈幷肆幽安四州軍事、開府儀同三司、幷州刺史。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned, Shizong came in person to mourn; posthumously granted command of military affairs in the four provinces of Bing, Si, You, and An, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, and Governor of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin returned, Gao Cheng came in person to mourn; posthumously he was granted command of military affairs in the four provinces of Bing, Si, You, and An, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, and governor of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 斛律羌舉

translations.literal: Hulu Qiangju
translations.idiomatic: Hulu Qiangju

sentences.zh: 斛律羌舉，太安人也。

translations.literal: Hulu Qiangju was a native of Tai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Hulu Qiangju was a native of Tai'an.

sentences.zh: 世為部落酋長。

translations.literal: For generations his family were chieftains of the tribe.
translations.idiomatic: For generations his family were chieftains of the tribe.

sentences.zh: 父謹，魏龍驤將軍、武川鎮將。

translations.literal: His father Jin served in Wei as General of Flying Cavalry and commandant of Wuchuan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jin served in Wei as general of flying cavalry and commandant of Wuchuan garrison.

sentences.zh: 羌舉少驍果，有膽力。

translations.literal: Qiangju in youth was fierce and resolute, with courage and strength.
translations.idiomatic: Qiangju in youth was fierce and resolute, with courage and strength.

sentences.zh: 永安中，從尒朱兆入洛，有戰功，深為兆所愛遇，恒從征伐。

translations.literal: During Yong'an he followed Erzhu Zhao into Luoyang, distinguished himself in battle, won Zhao's particular favor, and was constantly sent on campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: During Yong'an he followed Erzhu Zhao into Luoyang, distinguished himself in battle, won Zhao's particular favor, and was constantly sent on campaigns.

sentences.zh: 高祖破兆，方始歸誠。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor defeated Zhao, only then did he pledge genuine allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan defeated Zhao, only then did he pledge genuine allegiance.

sentences.zh: 高祖以其忠於所事，亦加嗟賞。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, because he had been loyal to whom he served, also praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, because he had been loyal to whom he served, also praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 天平中，除大都督，令率步騎三千導衆軍西襲夏州，剋之。

translations.literal: During Tianping he was appointed Grand Commander and ordered to lead three thousand infantry and cavalry to guide the army in a surprise western strike against Xia Province, which they captured.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianping he was appointed grand commander and ordered to lead three thousand infantry and cavalry to guide the army in a surprise western strike against Xia Province, which they captured.

sentences.zh: 後從高祖西討，大軍濟河，集諸將議進趣之計。

translations.literal: Later he accompanied the Grand Ancestor on the western campaign; when the main host forded the river, the generals gathered to debate their line of advance.
translations.idiomatic: Later he accompanied Gao Huan on the western campaign; when the main host forded the river, the generals gathered to debate their line of advance.

sentences.zh: 羌舉曰：「黑獺聚兇黨，強弱可知，若欲固守，無糧援可恃。

translations.literal: Qiangju said: "Black Badger has gathered a band of villains; their relative strength is known. If they seek only to hold fast, they have no grain or support to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Qiangju said: "Yuwen Tai has gathered a band of villains; their relative strength is known. If they seek only to hold fast, they have no grain or support to rely on.

sentences.zh: 今揣其情，已同困獸，若不與其戰，而逕趣咸陽，咸陽空虛，可不戰而克。

translations.literal: Now judging their state of mind, they are already like cornered beasts. If we do not give battle but press straight toward Xianyang, Xianyang stands empty and can be taken without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Now judging their state of mind, they are already like cornered beasts. If we do not give battle but press straight toward Xianyang, Xianyang stands empty and can be taken without fighting.

sentences.zh: 拔其根本，彼無所歸，則黑獺之首懸於軍門矣。

translations.literal: Strike at the root, and they will have nowhere to return — then Black Badger's head can hang at the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: Strike at the root, and they will have nowhere to return — then Yuwen Tai's head can hang at the army gate.

sentences.zh: 」諸將議有異同，遂戰於渭曲，大軍敗績。

translations.literal: " The generals disputed the plan, so they fought at the bend of the Wei and the main army suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: " The generals disputed the plan, so they fought at the bend of the Wei and the main army suffered a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 天平末，潁川人張儉聚衆反叛，西通關右，羌舉隨都督侯景、高昂等討破之。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianping, Zhang Jian of Yingchuan gathered a crowd in rebellion and coordinated with the west through the passes; Qiangju followed commanders Hou Jing, Gao Ang, and others to attack and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianping, Zhang Jian of Yingchuan gathered a crowd in rebellion and coordinated with the west through the passes; Qiangju followed commanders Hou Jing, Gao Ang, and others to attack and defeat them.

sentences.zh: 元象中，除清州刺史，封密縣侯。

translations.literal: In the Yuanxiang era he was appointed Governor of Qing Province and enfeoffed Marquis of Mi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanxiang era he was appointed governor of Qing Province and enfeoffed marquis of Mi County.

sentences.zh: 興和初，高祖以為中軍大都督，尋轉東夏州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xinghe, the Grand Ancestor made him Grand Commander of the Central Army and soon transferred him to Governor of Dongxia Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xinghe, Gao Huan made him grand commander of the central army and soon transferred him to governor of Dongxia Province.

sentences.zh: 時高祖欲招懷遠夷，令羌舉使於阿至羅，宣揚威德，前後稱旨，甚被知賞。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor wished to win over distant tribes, so he had Qiangju go as envoy to the Azhiluo people to proclaim majesty and virtue; he pleased his superiors repeatedly and was greatly valued.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan wished to win over distant tribes, so he had Qiangju go as envoy to the Azhiluo people to proclaim majesty and virtue; he pleased his superiors repeatedly and was greatly valued.

sentences.zh: 卒於州，時年三十六。

translations.literal: He died in the province at thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the province at thirty-six.

sentences.zh: 高祖深悼惜之。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor mourned him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan mourned him deeply.

sentences.zh: 贈幷恒二州軍事、恒州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted command of military affairs in Bing and Heng provinces and Governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted command of military affairs in Bing and Heng provinces and governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 斛律孝卿

translations.literal: Hulu Xiaoging
translations.idiomatic: Hulu Xiaoging

sentences.zh: 子孝卿，少聰敏幾悟，有風檢，頻歷顯職。

translations.literal: His son Xiaoging from youth was intelligent, perceptive, and dignified, and repeatedly held prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiaoging from youth was intelligent, perceptive, and dignified, and repeatedly held prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 武平末，侍中、開府儀同三司，封義寧王，知內省事，典外兵、騎兵機密。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuping he was palace attendant, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, enfeoffed Prince of Yining, managed the inner court, and controlled the secrets of external and cavalry forces.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuping he was palace attendant, opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, enfeoffed prince of Yining, managed the inner court, and controlled the secrets of external and cavalry forces.

sentences.zh: 是時，朝綱日亂，政由群豎。

translations.literal: At that time court discipline daily fell into chaos and policy rested with scheming eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time court discipline daily fell into chaos and policy rested with scheming eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 自趙彥深死，朝貴典機密者，唯孝卿一人差居雅道，不至貪穢。

translations.literal: After Zhao Yanshen died, among court nobles holding confidential posts only Xiaoging stood somewhat in the upright path and did not sink into greed and corruption.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhao Yanshen died, among court nobles holding confidential posts only Xiaoging stood somewhat in the upright path and did not sink into greed and corruption.

sentences.zh: 後主至齊州，以孝卿為尚書令。

translations.literal: When the Later Lord reached Qizhou he made Xiaoging Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Later Lord reached Qizhou he made Xiaoging director of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 又以中書侍郎薛道衡為侍中，封北海王。

translations.literal: He also appointed Palace Attendant Secretariat member Xue Daohang as palace attendant and enfeoffed him Prince of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: He also appointed palace attendant secretariat member Xue Daohang as palace attendant and enfeoffed him prince of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 二人勸後主作承光主詔，禪位任城王，令孝卿齎詔策及傳國璽往瀛州。

translations.literal: The two urged the Later Lord to draw up the Chengguang Sovereign decree abdicating in favor of the Prince of Rencheng, and had Xiaoging carry the decree documents and the imperial seal to Ying Province.
translations.idiomatic: The two urged the Later Lord to draw up the Chengguang Sovereign decree abdicating in favor of the Prince of Rencheng, and had Xiaoging carry the decree documents and the imperial seal to Ying Province.

sentences.zh: 孝卿便詣鄴城，歸於周武帝，仍從入長安，授納言上士。

translations.literal: Xiaoging instead went straight to Ye, submitted to Emperor Wu of Zhou, and followed him into Chang'an, where he was given the rank of superior presenter.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoging instead went straight to Ye, submitted to Emperor Wu of Zhou, and followed him into Chang'an, where he was given the rank of superior presenter.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇中，位太府卿，卒於民部尚書。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he rose to Grand Minister of the Treasury and died while serving as Minister of the People.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he rose to grand minister of the treasury and died while serving as minister of the people.

sentences.zh: 劉世清

translations.literal: Liu Shiqing
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiqing

sentences.zh: 代人劉世清，祖拔，魏燕州刺史；

translations.literal: Liu Shiqing of Dai — his grandfather Ba served in Wei as Governor of Yan Province;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiqing of Dai — his grandfather Ba served in Wei as governor of Yan Province;

sentences.zh: 父巍，金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: his father Wei held the position of Grand Master of Golden Crown and Purple Radiance.
translations.idiomatic: his father Wei held the position of grand master of golden crown and purple radiance.

sentences.zh: 世清武平末侍中、開府儀同三司，任遇與孝卿相亞。

translations.literal: Shiqing at the end of Wuping was palace attendant and opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, with appointment and favor nearly matching Xiaoging's.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing at the end of Wuping was palace attendant and opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators, with appointment and favor nearly matching Xiaoging's.

sentences.zh: 情性甚整，周慎謹密，在孝卿之右。

translations.literal: His disposition was very upright, his conduct cautious and meticulous, exceeding Xiaoging in these respects.
translations.idiomatic: His disposition was very upright, his conduct cautious and meticulous, exceeding Xiaoging in these respects.

sentences.zh: 能通四夷語，為當時第一。

translations.literal: He could speak the languages of the four barbarian peoples and ranked first in the age.
translations.idiomatic: He could speak the languages of the four barbarian peoples and ranked first in the age.

sentences.zh: 後主命世清作突厥語翻《涅盤經》，以遺突厥可汗，敕中書侍郎李德林為其序。

translations.literal: The Later Lord ordered him to translate the Nirvana Sutra into Turkic to present to the Turk khagan, and commanded Palace Attendant Secretariat member Li Delin to write its preface.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Lord ordered him to translate the Nirvana Sutra into Turkic to present to the Turk khagan, and commanded palace attendant secretariat member Li Delin to write its preface.

sentences.zh: 世清隋開皇中卒於開府、親衛驃騎將軍。

translations.literal: Shiqing died in the Kaihuang era of Sui while holding the rank of opener of a government office and personal guard flying-cavalry general.
translations.idiomatic: Shiqing died in the Kaihuang era of Sui while holding the rank of opener of a government office and personal guard flying-cavalry general.

sentences.zh: 堯雄，字休武，上黨長子人也。

translations.literal: Yao Xiong, styled Xiuwu, was a native of Changzi in Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong, styled Xiuwu, was a native of Changzi in Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 祖暄，魏司農卿。

translations.literal: His grandfather Xuan served in Wei as Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xuan served in Wei as minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 父榮，員外侍郎，雄少驍果，善騎射，輕財重氣，為時輩所重。

translations.literal: His father Rong was an outside-section member of the Secretariat; Xiong in youth was fierce and resolute, skilled in mounted archery, and lightly valued wealth while heavily valuing integrity, winning esteem among his peers.
translations.idiomatic: His father Rong was an outside-section member of the secretariat; Yao Xiong in youth was fierce and resolute, skilled in mounted archery, lightly valued wealth while heavily valuing integrity, and won esteem among his peers.

sentences.zh: 永安中，拜宣威將軍、給事中、持節慰勞恒燕朔三州大使。

translations.literal: During Yong'an he was appointed General Who Proclaims Military Might, attendant at the court, bearer of the staff sent to comfort and encourage the three provinces of Heng, Yan, and Shuo, and was then made a commander to follow Chilie Yan in suppressing Liu Lingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: During Yong'an he was appointed general who proclaims military might, attendant at the court, bearer of the staff sent to comfort and encourage the three provinces of Heng, Yan, and Shuo, and was then made a commander to follow Chilie Yan in suppressing Liu Lingzhu.

sentences.zh: 仍為都督，從叱列延討劉靈助，平之，拜鎮東將軍、燕州刺史，封城平縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: When that was pacified he was appointed General Who Pacifies the East, Governor of Yan Province, enfeoffed Baron of Chengping County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When that was pacified he was appointed general who pacifies the east, governor of Yan Province, enfeoffed baron of Chengping County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 義旗初建，雄隨尒朱兆敗於廣阿，遂率所部據定州以歸高祖。

translations.literal: When the banner of righteousness was first raised, Xiong followed Erzhu Zhao in defeat at Guang'a, then led his forces to hold Ding Province and return to the Grand Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner of righteousness was first raised, Yao Xiong followed Erzhu Zhao in defeat at Guang'a, then led his forces to hold Ding Province and return to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 時雄從兄傑，尒朱兆用為滄州刺史，至瀛州，知兆敗，亦遣使歸降。

translations.literal: At the time his elder cousin's son Jie, whom Erzhu Zhao had appointed Governor of Cang Province, reached Ying Province, learned of Zhao's defeat, and also sent envoys to submit and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his elder cousin's son Jie, whom Erzhu Zhao had appointed governor of Cang Province, reached Ying Province, learned of Zhao's defeat, and also sent envoys to submit and surrender.

sentences.zh: 高祖以其兄弟俱有誠款，便留傑行瀛州事，尋以雄為車騎大將軍、瀛州刺史以代傑，進爵為公，增邑五百戶。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor, because both brothers showed genuine good faith, kept Jie to administer Ying Province affairs and soon made Xiong General of Chariots and Cavalry, Governor of Ying Province in place of Jie, advancing his rank to Duke and increasing his fief by five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, because both brothers showed genuine good faith, kept Jie to administer Ying Province affairs and soon made Yao Xiong general of chariots and cavalry, governor of Ying Province in place of Jie, advancing his rank to duke and increasing his fief by five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 於時禁網疏闊，官司相與聚斂，唯雄義然後取，復能接下以寬恩，甚為吏民所懷附。

translations.literal: At the time restraints on the law were lax, and officials gathered wealth from one another, but Xiong took only what was proper; he could also treat subordinates with generous favor, and officials and commoners deeply attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time restraints on the law were lax, and officials gathered wealth from one another, but Yao Xiong took only what was proper; he could also treat subordinates with generous favor, and officials and commoners deeply attached themselves to him.

sentences.zh: 魏武帝入關，雄為大都督，隨高昂破賀拔勝於穰城。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu of Wei entered the Pass, Xiong served as Grand Commander and followed Gao Ang in defeating Heba Sheng at Rang city.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu of Wei entered the Pass, Yao Xiong served as grand commander and followed Gao Ang in defeating Heba Sheng at Rang city.

sentences.zh: 周旋征討三荊，仍除二豫、揚、郢四州都督、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: He campaigned back and forth in the pacification of the three Jing regions and was then appointed area commander over the four provinces of Two Yu, Yang, and Ying, and Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned back and forth in the pacification of the three Jing regions and was then appointed area commander over the four provinces of Two Yu, Yang, and Ying, and governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 元洪威據潁州叛，民趙繼宗殺潁川太守邵招，據樂口，自稱豫州刺史，北應洪威。

translations.literal: Yuan Hongwei held Ying Province in rebellion; the commoner Zhao Jizong killed the Administrator of Yingchuan, Shao Zhao, seized Lekou, styled himself Governor of Yu Province, and responded to Hongwei in the north.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hongwei held Ying Province in rebellion; the commoner Zhao Jizong killed the administrator of Yingchuan, Shao Zhao, seized Lekou, styled himself governor of Yu Province, and responded to Hongwei in the north.

sentences.zh: 雄率衆討之，繼宗敗走。

translations.literal: Xiong led troops to attack, and Jizong was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong led troops to attack, and Jizong was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 民因雄之出，遂推城人王長為刺史，據州引西魏。

translations.literal: Because Xiong had marched out, the people then pushed the city man Wang Chang to be governor, held the province, and invited Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yao Xiong had marched out, the people then pushed the city man Wang Chang to be governor, held the province, and invited Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 雄復與行臺侯景討平之。

translations.literal: Xiong again joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong again joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 梁將李洪芝、王當伯襲破平鄉城，侵擾州境。

translations.literal: Liang generals Li Hongzhi and Wang Dangbo raided and took Pingxiang city, harrying the province borders.
translations.idiomatic: Liang generals Li Hongzhi and Wang Dangbo raided and took Pingxiang city, harrying the province borders.

sentences.zh: 雄設伏要擊，生擒洪芝、當伯等，俘獲甚衆。

translations.literal: Xiong set an ambush and struck; Hongzhi, Dangbo, and others were captured alive and the booty was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong set an ambush and struck; Hongzhi, Dangbo, and others were captured alive and the booty was very great.

sentences.zh: 梁司州刺史陳慶之復率衆逼州城，雄出與戰，所向披靡，身被二創，壯氣益厲，慶之敗，棄輜重走。

translations.literal: Liang Minister of the Si Province Chen Qingzhi again led troops to press the provincial city; Xiong rode out to fight, swept all before him, took two wounds, and his fighting spirit grew fiercer still. Qingzhi was defeated and abandoned his baggage train in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Liang minister of the Si Province Chen Qingzhi again led troops to press the provincial city; Yao Xiong rode out to fight, swept all before him, took two wounds, and his fighting spirit grew fiercer still. Qingzhi was defeated and abandoned his baggage train in flight.

sentences.zh: 後慶之復圍南荊州，雄曰：「白茍堆，梁之北面重鎮，因其空虛，攻之必剋，彼若聞難，荊圍自解，此所謂機不可失也。

translations.literal: Later when Qingzhi again besieged Southern Jing Province, Xiong said: "Baigou Mound is a key strongpoint on Liang's northern frontier; attacking it while it lies empty will surely succeed. If they hear of the danger, the siege of Jing will lift of itself — this is an opportunity that must not be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Later when Qingzhi again besieged Southern Jing Province, Yao Xiong said: "Baigou Mound is a key strongpoint on Liang's northern frontier; attacking it while it lies empty will surely succeed. If they hear of the danger, the siege of Jing will lift of itself — this is an opportunity that must not be lost.

sentences.zh: 」遂率衆攻之，慶之果棄荊州來。

translations.literal: " He then led troops to attack it, and Qingzhi indeed abandoned Jing Province and came.
translations.idiomatic: " He then led troops to attack it, and Qingzhi indeed abandoned Jing Province and came.

sentences.zh: 未至，雄陷其城，擒梁鎮將茍元廣，兵二千人。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, Xiong had already taken the city, capturing Liang's garrison commander Gou Yuanguang and two thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived, Yao Xiong had already taken the city, capturing Liang's garrison commander Gou Yuanguang and two thousand soldiers.

sentences.zh: 梁以元慶和為魏王，侵擾南城。

translations.literal: Liang installed Yuan Qinghe as King of Wei to harass the southern wall.
translations.idiomatic: Liang installed Yuan Qinghe as King of Wei to harass the southern wall.

sentences.zh: 雄率衆討之，大破慶和於南頓。

translations.literal: Xiong led troops to attack and inflicted a great defeat on Qinghe at Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong led troops to attack and inflicted a great defeat on Qinghe at Nandun.

sentences.zh: 尋與行臺侯景破梁楚城。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing in breaking Liang's Chucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing in breaking Liang's Chucheng.

sentences.zh: 豫州民上書，更乞雄為刺史，復行豫州事。

translations.literal: The people of Yu Province memorialized, again requesting Xiong as governor, and he again administered Yu Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Yu Province memorialized, again requesting Yao Xiong as governor, and he again administered Yu Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 潁州長史賀若徽執刺史田迅，據州降西魏，詔雄與廣州刺史趙育、揚州刺史是云寶等各總當州士馬，隨行臺任延敬並勢攻之。

translations.literal: Chief clerk of Ying Province He Ruo Hui seized Governor Tian Xun, held the province, and surrendered to Western Wei; an edict ordered Xiong together with Guang Province Governor Zhao Yu, Yang Province Governor Shiyun Bao, and others each to command their provincial forces and cavalry, and with the mobile-office commander Ren Yanjing combine strength to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerk of Ying Province He Ruo Hui seized Governor Tian Xun, held the province, and surrendered to Western Wei; an edict ordered Yao Xiong together with Guang Province Governor Zhao Yu, Yang Province Governor Shiyun Bao, and others each to command their provincial forces and cavalry, and with the mobile-office commander Ren Yanjing combine strength to attack.

sentences.zh: 西魏遣其將怡鋒率衆援之，延敬等與戰失利。

translations.literal: Western Wei sent its general Yi Feng leading troops to reinforce them; Yanjing and the others fought and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei sent its general Yi Feng leading troops to reinforce them; Ren Yanjing and the others fought and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 育、寶各還本州，據城降敵。

translations.literal: Yu and Bao each returned to their own provinces, held the cities, and surrendered to the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yu and Shiyun Bao each returned to their own provinces, held the cities, and surrendered to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 雄收集散卒，保大梁。

translations.literal: Xiong gathered the scattered troops and held Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong gathered the scattered troops and held Daliang.

sentences.zh: 周文帝因延敬之敗，遣其右丞韋孝寬等攻豫州。

translations.literal: Because of Yanjing's defeat, Emperor Wen of Zhou sent his right deputy chief minister Wei Xiaokuan and others to attack Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Ren Yanjing's defeat, Yuwen Tai sent his right deputy chief minister Wei Xiaokuan and others to attack Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 雄都督郭丞伯、程多寶等舉豫州降敵，執刺史馮邕並家屬及部下妻子數千口，欲送之長安。

translations.literal: Xiong's commanders Guo Chengbai and Cheng Duobao and others raised Yu Province and surrendered to the enemy, seized Governor Feng Yong together with his family and the wives and children of his subordinates, several thousand persons in all, and intended to send them to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong's commanders Guo Chengbai and Cheng Duobao and others raised Yu Province and surrendered to the enemy, seized Governor Feng Yong together with his family and the wives and children of his subordinates, several thousand persons in all, and intended to send them to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 至樂口，雄外兵參軍王恒伽、都督赫連儁等數十騎從大梁邀之，斬多寶，拔雄等家口還大梁。

translations.literal: At Lekou, Xiong's outside-military military assistant Wang Hengjia and commander Helian Jun and others, several dozen horsemen from Daliang, intercepted them on the way, cut down Duobao, and rescued Xiong's family and dependents, returning them to Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: At Lekou, Yao Xiong's outside-military military assistant Wang Hengjia and commander Helian Jun and others, several dozen horsemen from Daliang, intercepted them on the way, cut down Duobao, and rescued Yao Xiong's family and dependents, returning them to Daliang.

sentences.zh: 西魏以丞伯為潁川太守，雄仍與行臺侯景討之。

translations.literal: Western Wei made Chengbai Administrator of Yingchuan, and Xiong again joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made Chengbai administrator of Yingchuan, and Yao Xiong again joined the mobile-office commander Hou Jing to attack him.

sentences.zh: 雄別攻破樂口，擒丞伯。

translations.literal: Xiong separately broke Lekou and captured Chengbai.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong separately broke Lekou and captured Chengbai.

sentences.zh: 進討懸瓠，逐西魏刺史趙繼宗、韋孝寬等。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Xuanhu, he drove off Western Wei governors Zhao Jizong, Wei Xiaokuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to attack Xuanhu, he drove off Western Wei governors Zhao Jizong, Wei Xiaokuan, and others.

sentences.zh: 復以雄行豫州事。

translations.literal: Xiong was again put in charge of Yu Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong was again put in charge of Yu Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 西魏以是云寶為揚州刺史，據項城；

translations.literal: Western Wei made Shiyun Bao Governor of Yang Province and had him hold Xiang city;
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made Shiyun Bao governor of Yang Province and had him hold Xiang city;

sentences.zh: 義州刺史韓顯據南頓。

translations.literal: Yizhou Governor Han Xian held Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou governor Han Xian held Nandun.

sentences.zh: 雄復率衆攻之，一日拔其二城，擒顯及長史丘嶽，寶遁走，獲其妻妾將吏二千人，皆傳送京師。

translations.literal: Xiong again led troops to attack; in a single day he took two of their cities, captured Xian and chief administrator Qiu Yue; Yunbao fled; they seized his wives, concubines, officers, and clerks — two thousand people in all — and sent them all to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong again led troops to attack; in a single day he took two of their cities, captured Han Xian and chief administrator Qiu Yue; Shi Yunbao fled; they seized his wives, concubines, officers, and clerks — two thousand people in all — and sent them all to the capital.

sentences.zh: 加驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: He was additionally made Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was additionally made grand general of agile cavalry.

sentences.zh: 仍隨侯景平魯陽，除豫州刺史。

translations.literal: He still followed Hou Jing in pacifying Luyang and was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: He still followed Hou Jing in pacifying Luyang and was appointed governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 雄雖武將，而性質寬厚，治民頗有誠信，為政去煩碎，舉大綱而已。

translations.literal: Though Xiong was a military man, his nature was generous and mild; in governing the people he was quite trustworthy; in administration he cast off petty detail and grasped only the great outline.
translations.idiomatic: Though Yao Xiong was a military man, his nature was generous and mild; in governing the people he was quite trustworthy; in administration he cast off petty detail and grasped only the great outline.

sentences.zh: 撫養兵民，得其力用。

translations.literal: He nurtured soldiers and commoners alike and gained their useful strength.
translations.idiomatic: He nurtured soldiers and commoners alike and gained their useful strength.

sentences.zh: 在邊十年，屢有功績，豫人於今懷之。

translations.literal: At the frontier for ten years he repeatedly achieved merit; the people of Yu still cherish his memory to this day.
translations.idiomatic: At the frontier for ten years he repeatedly achieved merit; the people of Yu still cherish his memory to this day.

sentences.zh: 又愛人物，多所施與，賓客往來，禮遺甚厚，亦以此見稱。

translations.literal: He also loved talented men and gave generously; guests coming and going received lavish courtesy and gifts — for this too he won renown.
translations.idiomatic: He also loved talented men and gave generously; guests coming and going received lavish courtesy and gifts — for this too he won renown.

sentences.zh: 興和三年，徵還京師，尋領司、冀、瀛、定、齊、青、膠、兗、殷、滄十州士卒十萬人，巡行西南，分守險要。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xinghe he was recalled to the capital; soon he was put in command of a hundred thousand soldiers from the ten provinces of Si, Ji, Ying, Ding, Qi, Qing, Jiao, Yan, Yin, and Cang, touring the southwest and assigning garrisons at strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xinghe he was recalled to the capital; soon he was put in command of a hundred thousand soldiers from the ten provinces of Si, Ji, Ying, Ding, Qi, Qing, Jiao, Yan, Yin, and Cang, touring the southwest and assigning garrisons at strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒於鄴，時年四十四。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died at Ye; he was forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at Ye. He was forty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、都督青徐膠三州軍事、大將軍、司徒公、徐州刺史，謚武恭。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, command over military affairs in the three provinces of Qing, Xu, and Jiao, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Governor of Xu Province; posthumous title Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff, command over military affairs in the three provinces of Qing, Xu, and Jiao, grand general, minister over the masses, and governor of Xu Province; posthumous title Wugong.

sentences.zh: 子師嗣。

translations.literal: His son Shisi succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shisi succeeded.

sentences.zh: 雄弟奮，字彥舉。

translations.literal: Xiong's younger brother Fen, styled Yanju.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong's younger brother Fen, styled Yanju.

sentences.zh: 解褐宣威將軍、給事中，轉中堅將軍、金紫光祿大夫，賜爵安夷縣子。

translations.literal: On entering office he was made General Who Proclaims Might and Gentleman within the Gates; transferred to General of the Central Guard and Grand Master for the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; granted the title Viscount of Anyi County.
translations.idiomatic: On entering office he was made general who proclaims might and gentleman within the gates; transferred to general of the central guard and grand master for the golden seal and purple ribbon; granted the title viscount of Anyi County.

sentences.zh: 從高祖平鄴，破尒朱兆等，進爵為伯。

translations.literal: Following Gao Huan in pacifying Ye and defeating Erzhu Zhao and others, his rank was advanced to Baron.
translations.idiomatic: Following Gao Huan in pacifying Ye and defeating Erzhu Zhao and others, his rank was advanced to baron.

sentences.zh: 出為南汾州刺史，胡夷畏憚之。

translations.literal: Sent out as Governor of Southern Fen Province; the Hu and barbarian peoples feared and respected him.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as governor of Southern Fen Province; the Hu and barbarian peoples feared and respected him.

sentences.zh: 西魏行臺薛崇禮舉衆攻奮，與戰，大破之，崇禮兄弟乞降，送於相府。

translations.literal: Western Wei mobile-office commissioner Xue Chongli raised troops to attack Fen; they gave battle and inflicted a great defeat; Chongli and his brothers begged to surrender and were sent to the chief minister's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei mobile-office commissioner Xue Chongli raised troops to attack Fen; they gave battle and inflicted a great defeat; Chongli and his brothers begged to surrender and were sent to the chief minister's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 轉奮驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫、潁州刺史，卒。

translations.literal: Fen was transferred to Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and Governor of Ying Province, then died.
translations.idiomatic: Fen was transferred to grand general of agile cavalry, left grand master for splendid happiness, and governor of Ying Province, then died.

sentences.zh: 贈兗豫梁三州諸軍事、司空、兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted command over military affairs in the three provinces of Yan, Yu, and Liang, Minister of Works, and Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted command over military affairs in the three provinces of Yan, Yu, and Liang, minister of works, and governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 雄從父兄傑，字壽。

translations.literal: Xiong's paternal cousin Jie, styled Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xiong's paternal cousin Jie, styled Shou.

sentences.zh: 性輕率，嗜酒，頗有武用。

translations.literal: His nature was reckless and impulsive; he loved wine and possessed considerable martial skill.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was reckless and impulsive; he loved wine and possessed considerable martial skill.

sentences.zh: 歷給事中、羽林監。

translations.literal: He successively served as Gentleman within the Gates and Supervisor of the Feathered Forest Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as gentleman within the gates and supervisor of the Feathered Forest guard.

sentences.zh: 從高祖破紇豆陵步藩有功，除鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: Following Gao Huan in defeating Hedouling Bufan he had merit and was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: Following Gao Huan in defeating Hedouling Bufan he had merit and was made general who pacifies the east.

sentences.zh: 封樂城縣伯，邑百戶。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed Baron of Lecheng County with a fief of a hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed baron of Lecheng County with a fief of a hundred households.

sentences.zh: 出為滄州刺史。

translations.literal: Sent out as Governor of Cang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as governor of Cang Province.

sentences.zh: 屬義兵起，歸高祖。

translations.literal: When the righteous host was raised, he returned to Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: When the righteous host was raised, he returned to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 從平鄴及破尒朱兆，進爵為侯。

translations.literal: Following in the pacification of Ye and the defeat of Erzhu Zhao, his rank was advanced to Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Following in the pacification of Ye and the defeat of Erzhu Zhao, his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 後為都督，率衆隨樊子鵠討元樹於譙城，平之。

translations.literal: Later as Area Commander he led troops following Fan Zihu in campaigning against Yuan Shu at Qiao City and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Later as area commander he led troops following Fan Zihu in campaigning against Yuan Shu at Qiao City and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 仍除南兗州，多所取受，然性果決，吏民畏之。

translations.literal: He was still appointed to Southern Yan Province; he accepted many bribes, yet his nature was resolute and decisive, and officials and commoners feared him.
translations.idiomatic: He was still appointed to Southern Yan Province; he accepted many bribes, yet his nature was resolute and decisive, and officials and commoners feared him.

sentences.zh: 尋加行兗州事。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally put in charge of Yan Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was additionally put in charge of Yan Province affairs.

sentences.zh: 元象初，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司，進爵為公。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators; his rank was advanced to Duke.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he was appointed grand general of chariots and cavalry and commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators; his rank was advanced to duke.

sentences.zh: 出為磨城鎮大都督，轉安州刺史，卒於州。

translations.literal: Sent out as Grand Commander of Mocheng Garrison; transferred to Governor of An Province; died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as grand commander of Mocheng garrison; transferred to governor of An Province; died in office.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、滄瀛二州諸軍事、尚書右僕射，滄州刺史，謚曰闕。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, command over military affairs in Cang and Ying provinces, Right Vice Director in the Masters of Writing, Governor of Cang Province; posthumous title left blank.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted bearer of the staff, command over military affairs in Cang and Ying provinces, right vice director in the masters of writing, and governor of Cang Province; posthumous title left blank.

sentences.zh: 宋顯，字仲華，敦煌效穀人也。

translations.literal: Song Xian, styled Zhonghua, was a native of Xiaogu in Dunhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Song Xian, styled Zhonghua, was a native of Xiaogu in Dunhuang.

sentences.zh: 性果敢，有幹用。

translations.literal: His nature was bold and resolute, with practical ability.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was bold and resolute, with practical ability.

sentences.zh: 初事尒朱榮為軍主，擢為長流參軍。

translations.literal: At first he served Erzhu Rong as army commander and was promoted to long-term-flow adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: At first he served Erzhu Rong as army commander and was promoted to long-term-flow adjutant.

sentences.zh: 永安中，除前軍、襄垣太守，轉榮府記室參軍。

translations.literal: During Yongan he was made front-army commander and Governor of Xiangyuan; transferred to record-keeping adjutant in Rong's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongan he was made front-army commander and governor of Xiangyuan; transferred to record-keeping adjutant in Rong's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 從平元顥，加平東將軍。

translations.literal: Following in the pacification of Yuan Hao, he was additionally made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: Following in the pacification of Yuan Hao, he was additionally made general who pacifies the east.

sentences.zh: 榮死，世隆等向洛，復以顯為襄垣太守。

translations.literal: When Rong died and Shilong and others marched on Luoyang, Xian was again appointed Governor of Xiangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died and Erzhu Shilong and others marched on Luoyang, Song Xian was again appointed governor of Xiangyuan.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，遷使持節、征北將軍、晉州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai he was transferred to Bearer of the Staff, General Who Campaigns North, and Governor of Jin Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putai he was transferred to bearer of the staff, general who campaigns north, and governor of Jin Province.

sentences.zh: 後歸高祖，以為行臺右丞。

translations.literal: Later he returned to Gao Huan and was made Right Vice Director in the Mobile Office.
translations.idiomatic: Later he returned to Gao Huan and was made right vice director in the mobile office.

sentences.zh: 樊子鵠據兗州反，前西兗州刺史乙瑗、譙郡太守辛景威屯據五梁，以應子鵠。

translations.literal: Fan Zihu held Yan Province in rebellion; former Western Yan Province Governor Yi Yuan and Qiao Commandery Governor Xin Jingwei garrisoned Wuliang in response to Zihu.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zihu held Yan Province in rebellion; former Western Yan Province governor Yi Yuan and Qiao Commandery governor Xin Jingwei garrisoned Wuliang in response to Zihu.

sentences.zh: 高祖以顯行西兗州事，率衆討破之，斬瑗，景威遁走。

translations.literal: Gao Huan put Xian in charge of Western Yan Province affairs; he led troops, defeated them, beheaded Yuan, and Jingwei fled.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan put Song Xian in charge of Western Yan Province affairs; he led troops, defeated them, beheaded Yi Yuan, and Xin Jingwei fled.

sentences.zh: 拜西兗州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Governor of Western Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Western Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 時梁州刺史鹿永吉據州外叛，西魏遣博陵王元約、趙郡王元景神率衆迎接。

translations.literal: At that time Liang Province Governor Lu Yongji held the province and rebelled; Western Wei sent Prince Yuan Yue of Boling and Prince Yuan Jingshen of Zhao Commandery with troops to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang Province governor Lu Yongji held the province and rebelled; Western Wei sent Prince Yuan Yue of Boling and Prince Yuan Jingshen of Zhao Commandery with troops to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 顯勒當州士馬邀破之，斬約等，仍與左衛將軍斛律平共會大梁。

translations.literal: Xian mustered the province's troops and cavalry, intercepted and defeated them, beheaded Yue and the others, then joined Left Guard General Hulu Ping at Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Song Xian mustered the province's troops and cavalry, intercepted and defeated them, beheaded Yuan Yue and the others, then joined left guard general Hulu Ping at Daliang.

sentences.zh: 拜儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was appointed Commissioner with Protocol Equal to Three Imperators.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commissioner with protocol equal to three imperators.

sentences.zh: 在州多所受納，然勇決有氣幹，檢御左右，咸能得其心力。

translations.literal: In the province he accepted many bribes, yet he was bold, resolute, and capable; in inspecting and controlling those around him, he could always win their wholehearted effort.
translations.idiomatic: In the province he accepted many bribes, yet he was bold, resolute, and capable; in inspecting and controlling those around him, he could always win their wholehearted effort.

sentences.zh: 及河陰之戰，深入赴敵，遂沒于行陣。

translations.literal: At the battle of Heyin he plunged deep to meet the enemy and perished in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Heyin he plunged deep to meet the enemy and perished in the battle line.

sentences.zh: 贈司空公。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted minister of works.

sentences.zh: 顯從祖弟繪，少勤學，多所博覽，好撰述，魏時，張緬《晉書》未入國，繪依準裴松之註《國志》體，註王隱及《中興書》。

translations.literal: Xian's second cousin Hui from youth studied diligently and read widely; he loved composing and annotating. In Wei times Zhang Mian's Book of Jin had not entered the realm; Hui, following the model of Pei Songzhi's commentary on the Records of the Three Kingdoms, annotated Wang Yin's works and the Book of the Restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Song Xian's second cousin Hui from youth studied diligently and read widely; he loved composing and annotating. In Wei times Zhang Mian's Book of Jin had not entered the realm; Hui, following the model of Pei Songzhi's commentary on the Records of the Three Kingdoms, annotated Wang Yin's works and the Book of the Restoration.

sentences.zh: 又撰《中朝多士傳》十卷，《姓系譜錄》五十篇。

translations.literal: He also composed the Ten Scrolls of Biographies of Many Scholars of the Central Court and the Fifty Chapters of Genealogical Records of Clans.
translations.idiomatic: He also composed the Ten Scrolls of Biographies of Many Scholars of the Central Court and the Fifty Chapters of Genealogical Records of Clans.

sentences.zh: 以諸家年歷不同，多有紕繆，乃刊正異同，撰《年譜錄》，未成，河清五年並遭水漂失。

translations.literal: Because various households' chronologies differed and contained many errors, he collated and corrected discrepancies and composed a Chronological Record — it was unfinished when in the fifth year of Heqing both works were lost in a flood.
translations.idiomatic: Because various households' chronologies differed and contained many errors, he collated and corrected discrepancies and composed a Chronological Record — it was unfinished when in the fifth year of Heqing both works were lost in a flood.

sentences.zh: 繪雖博聞強記，而天性恍惚，晚又遇風疾，言論遲緩。

translations.literal: Though Hui was broadly learned with a strong memory, his native disposition was absent-minded; in his later years he also suffered a wind ailment and his speech grew slow.
translations.idiomatic: Though Hui was broadly learned with a strong memory, his native disposition was absent-minded; in his later years he also suffered a wind ailment and his speech grew slow.

sentences.zh: 及失所撰之書，乃撫膺慟哭曰：「可謂天喪予也！

translations.literal: When the books he had composed were lost, he beat his breast and wept bitterly, saying: "This is truly Heaven's deathblow to me!
translations.idiomatic: When the books he had composed were lost, he beat his breast and wept bitterly, saying: "This is truly Heaven's deathblow to me!

sentences.zh: 」天統中卒。

translations.literal: " In the Tiantong era he died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the Tiantong era he died.

sentences.zh: 王則，字元軌，自云太原人也。

translations.literal: Wang Ze, styled Yuangui, claimed to be from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze, styled Yuangui, claimed to be from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 少驍果，有武藝。

translations.literal: From youth he was daring and resolute, with martial skill.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was daring and resolute, with martial skill.

sentences.zh: 初隨叔父魏廣平內史老生征討，每有戰功。

translations.literal: At first he followed his uncle, Wei interior secretary of Guangping Laisheng, on campaigns; each time he won military merit.
translations.idiomatic: At first he followed his uncle, Wei interior secretary of Guangping Laisheng, on campaigns; each time he won military merit.

sentences.zh: 老生為朝廷所知，則頗有力。

translations.literal: Laisheng came to be known to the court, and Ze had considerable influence through him.
translations.idiomatic: Laisheng came to be known to the court, and Wang Ze had considerable influence through him.

sentences.zh: 初以軍功除給事中，賜爵白水子。

translations.literal: At first for military merit he was made Gentleman within the Gates and granted the title Viscount of Baishui.
translations.idiomatic: At first for military merit he was made gentleman within the gates and granted the title viscount of Baishui.

sentences.zh: 後從元天穆討邢杲，輕騎深入，為杲所擒。

translations.literal: Later following Yuan Tianmu in campaigning against Xing Gao, he led light cavalry deep in and was captured by Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Later following Yuan Tianmu in campaigning against Xing Gao, he led light cavalry deep in and was captured by Gao.

sentences.zh: 元顥入洛，則與老生俱降顥，顥疑老生，遂殺之。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Ze and Laisheng both surrendered to Hao; Hao suspected Laisheng and thereupon killed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Wang Ze and Laisheng both surrendered to Hao; Hao suspected Laisheng and thereupon killed him.

sentences.zh: 則奔廣州刺史鄭先護，與同拒顥，顥敗，遷征虜將軍，出為東徐州防城都督。

translations.literal: Ze fled to Guangzhou Governor Zheng Xianhu, and together they resisted Hao; when Hao was defeated, Ze was promoted to General Who Subdues Captives and sent out as Area Commander defending the walls of Eastern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze fled to Guangzhou governor Zheng Xianhu, and together they resisted Hao; when Hao was defeated, Ze was promoted to general who subdues captives and sent out as area commander defending the walls of Eastern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮之死也，東徐州刺史斛斯椿其枝黨，內懷憂怖，時梁立魏汝南王悅為魏主，資其士馬，送境上，椿遂翻城降悅，則與蘭陵太守李義擊其偏師，破之。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong died, Eastern Xu Province Governor Hus Chun was one of his faction and inwardly feared; at that time Liang set up Prince Yue of Runan of Wei as ruler of Wei, supplied him with troops and horses, and escorted him to the border; Chun thereupon turned the city and surrendered to Yue; Ze together with Lanling Governor Li Yi struck their flank army and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong died, Eastern Xu Province governor Hus Chun was one of his faction and inwardly feared; at that time Liang set up Prince Yue of Runan of Wei as ruler of Wei, supplied him with troops and horses, and escorted him to the border; Chun thereupon turned the city and surrendered to Yue; Wang Ze together with Lanling governor Li Yi struck their flank army and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 魏因以則行北徐州事，後隸尒朱仲遠，仲遠敗，始歸高祖。

translations.literal: Wei thereupon put Ze in charge of Northern Xu Province affairs; later he came under Erzhu Zhongyuan; when Zhongyuan was defeated, he at last returned to Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Wei thereupon put Wang Ze in charge of Northern Xu Province affairs; later he came under Erzhu Zhongyuan; when Zhongyuan was defeated, he at last returned to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 仍加征南將軍、金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He was still additionally made General Who Campaigns South and Grand Master for the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: He was still additionally made general who campaigns south and grand master for the golden seal and purple ribbon.

sentences.zh: 初隨荊州刺史賀拔勝，後從行臺侯景，周旋征討，屢有功績。

translations.literal: At first he followed Jing Province Governor Heba Sheng; later he followed mobile-office commissioner Hou Jing, campaigning back and forth with repeated merit.
translations.idiomatic: At first he followed Jing Province governor Heba Sheng; later he followed mobile-office commissioner Hou Jing, campaigning back and forth with repeated merit.

sentences.zh: 天平初，行荊州事，都督三荊、二襄、南雍六州軍事，荊州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping he administered Jing Province affairs, commanding military affairs in the six provinces of the three Jing, two Xiang, and Southern Yong, and serving as Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping he administered Jing Province affairs, commanding military affairs in the six provinces of the three Jing, two Xiang, and Southern Yong, and serving as governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 則有威武，邊人畏服之。

translations.literal: Ze had martial prestige; frontier peoples feared and submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze had martial prestige; frontier peoples feared and submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 渭曲之役，則為西師圍逼，遂棄城奔梁。

translations.literal: At the battle of Weiqu, Ze was pressed hard by Western Wei forces and abandoned the city to flee to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Weiqu, Wang Ze was pressed hard by Western Wei forces and abandoned the city to flee to Liang.

sentences.zh: 梁尋放還，高祖怒而不責。

translations.literal: Liang soon sent him back; Gao Huan was angry but did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Liang soon sent him back; Gao Huan was angry but did not punish him.

sentences.zh: 元象初，除洛州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he was appointed Governor of Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang he was appointed governor of Luo Province.

sentences.zh: 則性貪婪，在州取受非法，舊京諸像，毀以鑄錢，于時世號河陽錢，皆出其家。

translations.literal: Ze's nature was greedy; in the province he accepted unlawful bribes; he destroyed the old capital's statues to cast coin — at the time the age called them Heyang coin, and all came from his household.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze's nature was greedy; in the province he accepted unlawful bribes; he destroyed the old capital's statues to cast coin — at the time the age called them Heyang coin, and all came from his household.

sentences.zh: 武定中，復隨侯景西討。

translations.literal: During Wuding he again followed Hou Jing on the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: During Wuding he again followed Hou Jing on the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 景於潁川作逆，時則鎮柏崖戍，世宗以則有武用，徵為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: When Jing rebelled at Yingchuan, Ze was then garrisoning the Biya garrison; Gao Cheng, because Ze had martial ability, summoned him to be Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled at Yingchuan, Wang Ze was then garrisoning the Biya garrison; Gao Cheng, because Ze had martial ability, summoned him to be governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 景既南附，梁遣貞陽侯蕭明率大衆向徐州，以為影響，堰清水灌州城。

translations.literal: Once Jing had submitted to the south, Liang sent the Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming with a great host toward Xu Province as coordinated support, damming the Qing River to flood the provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Once Hou Jing had submitted to the south, Liang sent the marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming with a great host toward Xu Province as coordinated support, damming the Qing River to flood the provincial city.

sentences.zh: 則固守歷時，而取受狼藉，鎖送晉陽，世宗恕其罪。

translations.literal: Ze held firm for a long time, but his bribe-taking was outrageous; he was chained and sent to Jinyang; Gao Cheng pardoned his crime.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze held firm for a long time, but his bribe-taking was outrageous; he was chained and sent to Jinyang; Gao Cheng pardoned his crime.

sentences.zh: 武定七年春，卒，時年四十八。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year of Wuding he died; he was forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year of Wuding he died. He was forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈青齊二州軍事、司空、青州刺史，謚曰烈懿。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted command over military affairs in Qing and Qi provinces, Minister of Works, Governor of Qing Province; posthumous title Lieyi.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was granted command over military affairs in Qing and Qi provinces, minister of works, and governor of Qing Province; posthumous title Lieyi.

sentences.zh: 王敬寶

translations.literal: Wang Jingbao
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingbao

sentences.zh: 則弟敬寶，少歷顯位。

translations.literal: Ze's younger brother Jingbao from youth rose through prominent posts.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze's younger brother Jingbao from youth rose through prominent posts.

sentences.zh: 後為東廣州刺史，與蕭軌等攻建業，不克，沒焉。

translations.literal: Later as Governor of Eastern Guang Province he joined Xiao Gui and others in attacking Jianye, failed to take it, and perished there.
translations.idiomatic: Later as governor of Eastern Guang Province he joined Xiao Gui and others in attacking Jianye, failed to take it, and perished there.

sentences.zh: 慕容紹宗

translations.literal: Murong Shaozong
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong

sentences.zh: 慕容紹宗，慕容晃第四子太原王恪後也，曾祖騰，歸魏，遂居於代。

translations.literal: Murong Shaozong was a descendant of Prince Ke of Taiyuan, fourth son of Murong Huang; his great-grandfather Teng submitted to Wei and thereafter settled in Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong was a descendant of Prince Ke of Taiyuan, fourth son of Murong Huang; his great-grandfather Teng submitted to Wei and thereafter settled in Dai.

sentences.zh: 祖都，岐州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Du was Governor of Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Du was governor of Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 父遠，恒州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Yuan was Governor of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuan was governor of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 紹宗容貌恢毅，少言語，深沈有膽略。

translations.literal: Shaozong's bearing was broad and resolute; he spoke little; he was deep and steady, with courage and design.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong's bearing was broad and resolute; he spoke little; he was deep and steady, with courage and design.

sentences.zh: 尒朱榮即其從舅子也。

translations.literal: Erzhu Rong was his mother's sister's son.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Rong was his mother's sister's son.

sentences.zh: 值北邊撓亂，紹宗攜家屬詣晉陽以歸榮，榮深待之。

translations.literal: When the northern frontier was in turmoil, Shaozong brought his household to Jinyang to join Rong; Rong treated him with deep favor.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern frontier was in turmoil, Shaozong brought his household to Jinyang to join Rong; Rong treated him with deep favor.

sentences.zh: 及榮稱兵入洛，私告紹宗曰：「洛中人士繁盛，驕侈成俗，若不加除剪，恐難制馭。

translations.literal: When Rong raised troops and entered Luoyang, he privately told Shaozong: "The gentry of Luoyang are numerous; pride and extravagance have become custom; if they are not cut down, I fear they will be hard to control.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong raised troops and entered Luoyang, he privately told Shaozong: "The gentry of Luoyang are numerous; pride and extravagance have become custom; if they are not cut down, I fear they will be hard to control.

sentences.zh: 吾欲因百官出迎，仍悉誅之，爾謂可不？

translations.literal: I wish to take the occasion when all officials come out to welcome me and put them all to the sword — what do you say, is that feasible?
translations.idiomatic: I wish to take the occasion when all officials come out to welcome me and put them all to the sword — what do you say, is that feasible?

sentences.zh: 」紹宗對曰：「太后臨朝，淫虐無道，天下憤惋，共所棄之。

translations.literal: " Shaozong replied: "The Empress Dowager holds court, licentious and cruel without the Way; the realm burns with indignation — all have cast her off.
translations.idiomatic: " Shaozong replied: "The empress dowager holds court, licentious and cruel without the Way; the realm burns with indignation — all have cast her off.

sentences.zh: 公既身控神兵，心執忠義，忽欲殲夷多士，謂非長策，深願三思。

translations.literal: Your Lordship now holds divine troops in hand and keeps loyalty and righteousness in heart; suddenly to wish to slaughter many scholars — I think that is no long-term plan; I deeply hope you will think thrice.
translations.idiomatic: Your Lordship now holds divine troops in hand and keeps loyalty and righteousness in heart; suddenly to wish to slaughter many scholars — I think that is no long-term plan; I deeply hope you will think thrice.

sentences.zh: 」榮不從。

translations.literal: " Rong did not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Rong did not heed him.

sentences.zh: 後以軍功封索盧縣子。

translations.literal: Later for military merit he was enfeoffed Viscount of Suolu County.
translations.idiomatic: Later for military merit he was enfeoffed viscount of Suolu County.

sentences.zh: 尋進爵為侯。

translations.literal: Soon his rank was advanced to Marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his rank was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 從高祖破羊侃，又與元天穆平邢杲，累遷幷州刺史。

translations.literal: Following Gao Huan in defeating Yang Kan, and with Yuan Tianmu in pacifying Xing Gao, he rose in succession to Governor of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Following Gao Huan in defeating Yang Kan, and with Yuan Tianmu in pacifying Xing Gao, he rose in succession to governor of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 紇豆陵步藩逼晉陽，尒朱兆擊之，累為步藩所破，欲以晉州徵高祖共圖步藩。

translations.literal: Hedouling Bufan pressed on Jinyang; Erzhu Zhao attacked him but was repeatedly broken by Bufan; Zhao wished to summon Gao Huan from Jin Province to join in plotting against Bufan.
translations.idiomatic: Hedouling Bufan pressed on Jinyang; Erzhu Zhao attacked him but was repeatedly broken by Bufan; Zhao wished to summon Gao Huan from Jin Province to join in plotting against Bufan.

sentences.zh: 紹宗諫曰：「今天下擾擾，人懷覬覦。

translations.literal: Shaozong remonstrated, saying: "Today the realm is in turmoil; men harbor covetous designs.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong remonstrated, saying: "Today the realm is in turmoil; men harbor covetous designs.

sentences.zh: 正是智士用策之秋。

translations.literal: It is precisely the season when men of wisdom employ stratagems.
translations.idiomatic: This is precisely the season when men of wisdom put stratagems to use.

sentences.zh: 高晉州才雄氣猛，英略蓋世，譬諸蛟龍，安可借以雲雨！

translations.literal: Governor Gao of Jinzhou is talented and fierce in spirit, his heroic designs surpassing the age — like a dragon or serpent; how could one borrow cloud and rain from him!
translations.idiomatic: Governor Gao of Jinzhou is talented and fierce in spirit, his heroic designs surpassing the age — he is like a dragon or serpent; how could one borrow cloud and rain from him!

sentences.zh: 」兆怒曰：「我與晉州推誠相待，何忽輒相猜阻，橫生此言！

translations.literal: Zhao angrily said: "I and Governor Gao of Jinzhou treat each other with open sincerity — why do you suddenly suspect and obstruct me and speak such words!
translations.idiomatic: Zhao flared with anger: "Governor Gao of Jinzhou and I treat each other with open sincerity — why do you suddenly suspect and obstruct me and speak such words!

sentences.zh: 」便禁止紹宗，數日方釋。

translations.literal: " He then placed Shaozong under detention; only after several days was he released.
translations.idiomatic: " He then placed Shaozong under detention; only after several days was he released.

sentences.zh: 遂割鮮卑隸高祖。

translations.literal: Thereupon he severed the Xianbei troops under his command and assigned them to Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he severed the Xianbei troops under his command and assigned them to Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 高祖共討步藩，滅之。

translations.literal: Gao Huan jointly campaigned against Bufan and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan jointly campaigned against Bufan and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 及高祖舉義信都，兆以紹宗為長史，又命為行臺，率軍壺關，以抗高祖。

translations.literal: When Gao Huan raised righteousness at Xindu, Zhao made Shaozong chief administrator, also appointing him mobile-office commissioner, leading troops at Huguan to resist Gao Huan.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan raised righteousness at Xindu, Zhao made Shaozong chief administrator and mobile-office commissioner, leading troops at Huguan to resist Gao Huan.

sentences.zh: 及廣阿、韓陵之敗，兆乃撫膺自咎，謂紹宗曰：「比用卿言，今豈至此！」

translations.literal: After the defeats at Guang'a and Hanling, Zhao beat his breast in self-reproach and said to Shaozong: "Had I heeded your words earlier, how could matters have come to this!"
translations.idiomatic: After the defeats at Guang'a and Hanling, Zhao beat his breast in self-reproach and said to Shaozong: "Had I heeded your words earlier, how could matters have come to this!"

sentences.zh: 兆之敗於韓陵也，士卒多奔，兆懼，將欲潛遁。

translations.literal: When Zhao was defeated at Hanling, many soldiers fled; Zhao was afraid and intended to slip away in secret.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao was broken at Hanling, many soldiers fled; Zhao was afraid and intended to slip away in secret.

sentences.zh: 紹宗建旗鳴角，招集義徒，軍容既振，與兆徐而上馬。

translations.literal: Shaozong raised banners and sounded horns, gathering loyal followers; once the army's bearing was restored, he and Zhao mounted their horses at an unhurried pace.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong raised banners and sounded horns, gathering loyal followers; once the army's bearing was restored, he and Zhao mounted their horses at an unhurried pace.

sentences.zh: 後高祖從鄴討兆於晉陽，兆窘急，走赤谼嶺，自縊而死。

translations.literal: Later Gao Huan marched from Ye to pursue Zhao at Jinyang; Zhao, pressed hard, fled to Chihong Ridge and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Later Gao Huan marched from Ye to pursue Zhao at Jinyang; Zhao, pressed hard, fled to Chihong Ridge and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 紹宗行到烏突城，見高祖追至，遂攜榮妻子及兆餘衆自歸。

translations.literal: As Shaozong was traveling and reached Wutu City, he saw Gao Huan pursuing close behind; he then brought Rong's wife and children and Zhao's remaining followers over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: As Shaozong was traveling and reached Wutu City, he saw Gao Huan pursuing close behind; he then brought Rong's wife and children and Zhao's remaining followers over in submission.

sentences.zh: 高祖仍加恩禮，所有官爵並如故，軍謀兵略，時參預焉。

translations.literal: Gao Huan still treated him with favor and courtesy; all his offices and ranks remained as before, and he took part in military planning and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan still treated him with favor and courtesy; all his offices and ranks remained as before, and he took part in military planning and strategy.

sentences.zh: 天平初，遷都鄴，庶事未周，乃令紹宗與高隆之共知府庫圖籍諸事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, when the capital was moved to Ye and many affairs were not yet settled, Shaozong and Gao Longzhi were ordered jointly to manage the treasury, archives, and related matters.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping, when the capital was moved to Ye and many affairs were not yet settled, Shaozong and Gao Longzhi were ordered jointly to manage the treasury, archives, and related matters.

sentences.zh: 二年，宜陽民李延孫聚衆反，乃以紹宗為西南道軍司，率都督厙狄安盛等討破之。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Yiyang man Li Yansun gathered a crowd in rebellion; Shaozong was made army marshal of the southwestern circuit and, leading Area Commander Kudi Ansheng and others, attacked and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Yiyang man Li Yansun gathered a crowd in rebellion; Shaozong was made army marshal of the southwestern circuit and, leading Area Commander Kudi Ansheng and others, attacked and broke them.

sentences.zh: 軍還，行揚州刺史，尋行青州刺史。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he served as acting governor of Yang Province; soon he served as acting governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he served as acting governor of Yang Province; soon he served as acting governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 丞相府記室孫搴屬紹宗以兄為州主簿，紹宗不用。

translations.literal: Sun Qian of the chief minister's secretariat, relying on Shaozong, had his elder brother appointed chief clerk of the province; Shaozong would not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Qian of the chief minister's secretariat, relying on Shaozong, had his elder brother appointed chief clerk of the province; Shaozong would not accept it.

sentences.zh: 搴譖之於高祖，云：「慕容紹宗嘗登廣固城長嘆，謂其所親云 『大丈夫有復先業理不』。

translations.literal: Qian slandered him to Gao Huan, saying: "Murong Shaozong once climbed the walls of Guanggu City and sighed long, telling those close to him, 'A great man ought to recover his ancestral enterprise — is that not so?'
translations.idiomatic: Qian slandered him to Gao Huan, saying: "Murong Shaozong once climbed the walls of Guanggu City and sighed long, telling those close to him, 'A great man ought to recover his ancestral enterprise — is that not so?'

sentences.zh: 」由是徵還。

translations.literal: " Because of this he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: " Because of this he was recalled.

sentences.zh: 元象初，西魏將獨孤如願據洛州，梁、潁之間，寇盜鋒起。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, the Western Wei general Dugu Ruyuan held Luozhou; between Liang and Ying, bandits and raiders rose in force.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanxiang, the Western Wei general Dugu Ruyuan held Luozhou; between Liang and Ying, bandits and raiders rose in force.

sentences.zh: 高祖命紹宗率兵赴武牢，與行臺劉貴等平之。

translations.literal: Gao Huan ordered Shaozong to lead troops to Wulao and, together with Mobile-Office Commissioner Liu Gui and others, pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan ordered Shaozong to lead troops to Wulao and, together with Mobile-Office Commissioner Liu Gui and others, pacify them.

sentences.zh: 進爵為公，除度支尚書。

translations.literal: His rank was advanced to duke, and he was appointed minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: His rank was advanced to duke, and he was appointed minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 後為晉州刺史、西道大行臺，還朝，遷御史中尉。

translations.literal: Later he became governor of Jin Province and western-circuit grand commissioner; on returning to court he was transferred to censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Later he became governor of Jin Province and western-circuit grand commissioner; on returning to court he was transferred to censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 屬梁人劉烏黑入寇徐方，令紹宗率兵討擊之，大破，因除徐州刺史。

translations.literal: When the Liang man Liu Wuhei invaded Xu Region, Shaozong was ordered to lead troops against him; he inflicted a great defeat and was then appointed governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liang man Liu Wuhei invaded Xu Region, Shaozong was ordered to lead troops against him; he inflicted a great defeat and was then appointed governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 烏黑收其散衆，復為侵竊，紹宗密誘其徒黨，數月間，遂執烏黑殺之。

translations.literal: Wuhei gathered his scattered troops and again raided and plundered; Shaozong secretly won over his followers, and within a few months seized Wuhei and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhei gathered his scattered troops and again raided and plundered; Shaozong secretly won over his followers, and within a few months seized Wuhei and killed him.

sentences.zh: 侯景反叛，命紹宗為東南道行臺，加開府，轉封燕郡公，與韓軌等詣瑕丘，以圖進趣。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled, Shaozong was appointed southeastern-circuit mobile-office commissioner, additionally given the seal of opening an office, transferred and enfeoffed Duke of Yan Commandery; with Han Gui and others he went to Xiqiu to plan the advance.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, Shaozong was appointed southeastern-circuit mobile-office commissioner, additionally given the seal of opening an office, transferred and enfeoffed duke of Yan Commandery; with Han Gui and others he went to Xiqiu to plan the advance.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝遣其兄子貞陽侯淵明等率衆十萬，頓軍寒山，與侯景掎角，擁泗水灌彭城。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang dispatched his elder brother's son, the Zhenyango Marquis Yuanming, and others, leading a hundred thousand men to encamp at Hanshan, coordinating with Hou Jing in pincer fashion and damming the Si River to flood Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang dispatched his elder brother's son, the Zhenyango Marquis Yuanming, and others, leading a hundred thousand men to encamp at Hanshan, coordinating with Hou Jing in pincer fashion and damming the Si River to flood Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 仍詔紹宗為行臺，節度三徐、二兗州軍事，與大都督高嶽等出討，大破之，擒淵明及其將帥等，俘虜其衆。

translations.literal: An edict still appointed Shaozong mobile-office commissioner, directing military affairs in the three Xu and two Yan provinces; with Grand Commander Gao Yue and others he marched out to attack and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Yuanming and his generals and taking their troops prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict still appointed Shaozong mobile-office commissioner, directing military affairs in the three Xu and two Yan provinces; with Grand Commander Gao Yue and others he marched out to attack and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Yuanming and his generals and taking their troops prisoner.

sentences.zh: 乃回軍討侯景於渦陽。

translations.literal: He then turned the army to attack Hou Jing at Woyang.
translations.idiomatic: He then turned the army to attack Hou Jing at Woyang.

sentences.zh: 于時景軍甚衆，前後諸將往者莫不為其所輕。

translations.literal: At that time Jing's army was very numerous; the generals sent before him were none that he did not hold in contempt.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jing's army was very numerous; none of the generals sent against him before escaped his contempt.

sentences.zh: 及聞紹宗與岳將至，深有懼色，謂其屬曰：「岳所部兵精，紹宗舊將，宜共慎之。

translations.literal: When he heard that Shaozong and Yue were about to arrive, he showed deep fear and said to his followers: "Yue's troops are elite, and Shaozong is an old commander — we should all be careful with them.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that Shaozong and Yue were about to arrive, he showed deep fear and said to his followers: "Yue's troops are elite, and Shaozong is an old commander — we should all be careful with them.

sentences.zh: 」於是與景接戰，諸將持疑，無肯先者，紹宗麾兵徑進，諸將從之，因而大捷，景遂奔遁。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he joined battle with Jing; the generals held back in doubt, none willing to go first, but Shaozong waved his troops straight forward and the generals followed; thus they won a great victory and Jing fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he joined battle with Jing; the generals held back in doubt, none willing to go first, but Shaozong waved his troops straight forward and the generals followed; thus they won a great victory and Jing fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 軍還，別封永樂縣子。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was separately enfeoffed Viscount of Yongle County.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was separately enfeoffed viscount of Yongle County.

sentences.zh: 初，高祖末，命世宗云：「侯景若反，以慕容紹宗當之。
